# RAVISN Omnichannel Autonomous Platform

> Production-grade omnichannel autonomous AI agent and outreach CRM platform.

## Architecture Summary
- **apps/core**: Laravel 11 / PHP 8.3 / Inertia React 19 / PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector / Redis 7.2
- **apps/agent**: FastAPI / Python 3.11 / LangGraph / Groq / Gemini / xAI Grok / OpenAI / Whisper
- **Channels**: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API v21.0), Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct
- **Storage**: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector extension (1536-dim HNSW cosine distance index)
- **Messaging Pipeline**: Meta Webhook (<150ms ACK) -> Redis Stream (`inbound_ai_jobs`) -> FastAPI LangGraph -> Redis Pub/Sub (`crm_channel_updates`) -> Laravel Reverb WebSocket UI & WhatsApp Outbound Dispatcher

## API Endpoints Reference

### Core Laravel Gateway (`http://localhost:8000`)
- `GET  /webhooks/meta`: Webhook verification challenge (hub.mode, hub.verify_token, hub.challenge)
- `POST /webhooks/meta`: Inbound message webhook with HMAC SHA-256 validation (`X-Hub-Signature-256`)
- `POST /api/v1/inbox/threads/{id}/toggle-bot`: Toggle autonomous AI response (`bot_active`: true/false)
- `POST /api/v1/inbox/threads/{id}/messages`: Send manual staff message (auto-pauses AI)
- `POST /api/v1/campaigns/{id}/send`: Trigger mass outbound campaign batch

### Agent FastAPI Intelligence Layer (`http://localhost:8001`)
- `GET  /api/v1/health`: Health status of database, redis, and provider cascade
- `POST /api/v1/chat`: Direct synchronous conversation execution through LangGraph
- `POST /api/v1/knowledge/ingest`: Ingest documents into pgvector knowledge base
- `POST /api/v1/process`: Trigger LangGraph workflow execution on state payload

## Multi-AI Provider Cascade Priority
1. Primary: Groq (`llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, temp 0.3)
2. Fallback 1: Google Gemini (`gemini-2.5-flash`)
3. Fallback 2: xAI Grok (`grok-3-mini`)
4. Fallback 3: OpenAI (`gpt-4o-mini` / `gpt-4o`)
5. Safety Net: Deterministic Offline Responder

## Hybrid RAG Architecture
- Dense: pgvector cosine distance (`1 - (embedding <=> chunk_vector)`)
- Sparse: PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (`ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('english', content), query)`)
- Fusion: Reciprocal rank score ($0.7 \times \text{dense} + 0.3 \times \text{sparse}$)
- CRAG Quality Grading: HIGH ($\ge 0.70$), MEDIUM ($0.45-0.70$), LOW ($<0.45$)
